title: Economía y globalización
goal: Read about remittances as a quietly massive economic force -- growing with Salvadoran, Central American and Mexican emigration and exceeding 20 billion dollars a year.

items: Describe how the figure kept rising as the Salvadoran community abroad grew.
Explain the relationship between rising emigration and rising remittances.
State roughly how large annual remittances were.
Use a medida que to describe two things changing together over time.
